schemaUsage: inputSchema/resultSchema references resolve against this catalog.$defs. Operation input context is stripped by the host and is not forwarded as feature parameters. Native queries do not accept context. Native source, authorization, bounds and exact CAS checks remain authoritative.

Uuid.description: Use the real UUID returned by Mewu; do not invent a source, scene, region or revision.

Region.description: A new screenshot region in ORIGINAL background pixels, not normalized 0–1 coordinates or viewport CSS pixels. Coordinates must fit the current background. No drawings, OCR, image override or history can be injected here.

Drawing.description: Manual markup in ORIGINAL background pixels. IDs are UUIDs; the current region drawingRevision is required by DrawingCommand.expectedRevision. Read the fresh document after each write. Native code checks bounds, point relationships, duplicate IDs, history, exact CAS and tool availability. This schema does not create rich/native layouts, provenance or executable SVG.

textRuns.description: Literal fragments must concatenate exactly to text. Omitted styles inherit the drawing; an empty textStyle clears effects.

DrawingCommand.description: A single durable edit/undo step. expectedRevision is the exact drawingRevision returned by scene.get or the previous mutation receipt. Never guess a revision or retry a failed/unknown write automatically. Native rich-layout references cannot be fabricated through this schema.

OcrTarget.description: Exact current region identity, drawing revision and original background-pixel geometry from scene.get. The host revalidates source and plugin authority before and after work.

SceneCommand.description: Finite scene changes only. Does not expose arbitrary Tauri commands, credential changes, MCP grants, filesystem operations or arbitrary Store commands.

RecordingStatus.description: Actual native recording status. stop/cancel may return a stopping state; they do not by themselves prove a completed playable file.
